label: Sonos Era 100 smart speaker
description: Sonos Era 100 is a stereo smart speaker with Sonos voice control, Alexa, AirPlay 2 and Bluetooth 5.0. Networking is WiFi-first: WiFi 6 on 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax at 2.4 and 5 GHz; there is no RJ45 jack on the speaker - Ethernet is only possible through the sold-separately USB-C Combo Adapter, and USB is not modelled as a network interface here, so treat it as wireless-only.
